0022600198.text: The Utah Jazz (1-8) come into their 10th game of the season on a seven-game losing streak, sitting 14th in the West and 6.5 games back in the Northwest, with a 0-4 road record. The Minnesota Timberwolves (7-3) are 2nd in the Northwest, one game back, on a three-game winning streak, and the Jazz lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 147-111 defeat in Minneapolis on March 18, 2026, while the 2026-27 season series has no games yet. Utah is missing Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), Keyonte George (illness, day-to-day) and Lauri Markkanen (wrist sprain, day-to-day), and Minnesota is without Anthony Edwards (knee surgery), Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles surgery) and Joan Beringer (fracture, day-to-day).
